info.title: Aruba ClearPass
info.description:
Authentication: OAuth 2.0 (client credentials grant) against ClearPass's built-in OAuth2 provider.

HPE Aruba Networking ClearPass Policy Manager Network Bound API (NBAPI) — network access control (NAC) policy administration: network devices and device groups, endpoints, local users, roles, RADIUS proxy targets, and static host lists.

Source: https://developer.arubanetworks.com/cppm/docs
